甲骨文（Oracle）已提交文件，拟通过发行新股与债券合计融资200亿美元，所筹资金将用于其人工智能基础设施的建设。该文件属于证券发行的注册申报，并非已完成的交易；目前尚未披露发行定价以及股权与债务融资的最终比例。

此次申报把甲骨文的AI数据中心投入直接摆到了股票与信用投资者面前，也引出市场已开始定价的两个问题：现有股东将被稀释多少，以及支撑这些支出的长期AI云合同能否经受时间考验。

甲骨文的AI云订单储备一直是其估值的重要支撑，在2027财年第一季度签下逾300亿美元新AI云合同后，其剩余履约义务总额据报达到6640亿美元。有评论者指出，若200亿美元中约一半通过股权融资，按当前市值计算意味着约2.5%的稀释，而该股股价已下跌8%。
metadata.market_impact_en: The deal links Oracle's equity and credit to the same AI-capex trade, so new supply of AI-linked corporate bonds and shares can influence credit spreads and risk appetite for the broader AI complex, including tokens tied to decentralized compute and AI narratives that trade off AI capex sentiment. The direct crypto channel is indirect — sentiment and general risk appetite rather than any protocol-level exposure.

dedup_history.ai_summary: The New York Times and other publishers sued Brave, alleging the privacy-focused browser scraped and unlawfully distributed their copyrighted content to customers through AI features.
dedup_history.author: Rebecca Bellan

metadata.background_en: Brave is an 11-year-old browser company built around privacy and ad blocking, and it markets a search API product alongside its consumer browser. A 2023 Brave guide cited in the complaint promoted the API for training and grounding large language models. According to the complaint, Brave also advertises "hundreds of top publishers" as accessible through its paywall-blocking feature.
metadata.background_zh: Brave 是一家成立 11 年、以隐私保护和广告拦截为核心的浏览器公司，除面向消费者的浏览器外还销售搜索 API 产品。诉状引用的 Brave 2023 年指南曾将该 API 宣传为可用于训练和接地大语言模型。诉状还称，Brave 宣传其付费墙拦截功能可访问“数百家顶级出版商”的内容。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
The New York Times and a group of other publishers, including the New York Daily News and the Chicago Tribune, filed lawsuits against Brave, the company behind the privacy-focused browser, alleging it scraped their copyrighted content and unlawfully distributed it to AI customers. The complaints, filed Monday, name Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI and Cohere as recipients of that content, and also challenge Brave's "Paywall blocker" feature, which the suit says let users bypass publishers' paywalls.

The suits target the supply layer of AI search — the index and API through which publishers' journalism reaches model developers — rather than a single model's training run, putting Brave's commercial search API and its paywall-bypass feature directly in legal question.

The complaint cites a 2023 Brave guide describing the most common API uses as "training and grounding" large language models, while Brave's current API terms, updated September 1, 2026, bar customers from caching or reselling results or using them to train or improve AI models. As of the filing these are allegations in a complaint; no court has ruled on the claims.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
《纽约时报》联合《纽约每日新闻》《芝加哥论坛报》等多家出版机构对隐私浏览器公司 Brave 提起诉讼，指控其抓取受版权保护的内容并违规分发给 AI 客户。诉状于周一提交，点名 Anthropic、Perplexity、Mistral、xAI 和 Cohere 为内容接收方，同时质疑 Brave 的“付费墙拦截器”功能，称其让用户绕过出版商的付费墙。

这些诉讼瞄准的是 AI 搜索的供给层——即把出版商新闻内容输送给模型开发者的索引与 API，而非某一次模型训练，这使 Brave 的商业搜索 API 及其绕过付费墙的功能直接面临法律质疑。

诉状引用 Brave 2023 年的一份指南，其中将 API 最常见的用途描述为对大语言模型进行“训练与接地（grounding）”；而 Brave 现行 API 条款（2026 年 9 月 1 日更新）禁止客户缓存、转售结果，或用其训练和改进 AI 模型。截至起诉之时，这些都还只是诉状中的指控，法院尚未作出任何裁决。
metadata.market_impact_en: The case tests legal exposure along the AI data-supply chain: the AI firms named as Brave customers — Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI and Cohere — could face scrutiny over how they source third-party web content, while Brave's own search API and its associated Basic Attention Token carry direct headline risk. A ruling either way would shape the cost and contractual terms of licensed content feeding AI search and grounding products.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该案检验的是 AI 数据供应链上的法律风险：被列为 Brave 客户的 Anthropic、Perplexity、Mistral、xAI 和 Cohere 可能因其第三方网页内容的获取方式而受到审查，而 Brave 自身的搜索 API 及其关联的 Basic Attention Token 则直接承受消息面风险。无论判决结果如何，都将影响为 AI 搜索与接地产品提供内容的授权成本与合同条款。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Anthropic is developing FlashProve, a system that would let anyone verify that an AI response genuinely originated from the model it claims to, addressing model-identity and impersonation concerns.
dedup_history.author: Russell Brandom

metadata.background_en: Model provenance has become a broader concern as hosted models are resold, routed and rebranded by third parties: related efforts include model signing work under OpenSSF, watermarking schemes such as SynthID, the C2PA content credential standard, and EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations. Attestation approaches generally pair an identity layer with a separate verification layer that the model provider does not solely control.
metadata.background_zh: 随着托管模型被第三方转售、路由和重新包装，模型来源已成为更广泛的关注点：相关努力包括 OpenSSF 旗下的模型签名工作、SynthID 等水印方案、C2PA 内容凭证标准，以及欧盟《人工智能法案》第 50 条的透明度义务。认证类方案通常将身份层与另一套验证层结合，而后者并非由模型提供方单独掌控。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Anthropic is developing FlashProve, an open source system that would let anyone verify which AI model produced a given output, according to a company blog post published Tuesday. The company demonstrated the approach using Llama 4 Maverick, a 400-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, running on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU.

The effort targets model-identity and impersonation concerns, aiming to give developers and platforms a way to check that a response genuinely came from the model it claims to originate from.

Anthropic describes FlashProve as an open source system, and the demo produced proofs on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU with Llama 4 Maverick. The system is still in development, with no shipped or widely adopted implementation yet.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据 Anthropic 周二发布的一篇博客文章，该公司正在研发一套名为 FlashProve 的开源系统，可让任何人验证某段 AI 输出究竟由哪个模型生成。Anthropic 用 Llama 4 Maverick（一个 4000 亿参数的混合专家模型）在单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 上演示了该方案。

该计划针对模型身份伪造与冒名问题，目标是让开发者和平台能够核验某段回复是否确实来自其所声称的模型。

Anthropic 将 FlashProve 描述为一套开源系统，演示中它借助单块 NVIDIA H100 GPU 与 Llama 4 Maverick 生成证明。该系统仍处于研发阶段，尚未发布或获得广泛采用的实现。
metadata.market_impact_en: If model attestation becomes standard, hosted-model resellers and API aggregators would face a new compliance and trust layer, since buyers could check which model actually served a request rather than relying on vendor claims. The channel is accountability and trust in model routing rather than token supply or liquidity, and it also touches verifiable-inference and AI-agent identity projects that market cryptographic proof of model execution.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 如果模型认证成为标准，托管模型转售商和 API 聚合商将面临新的合规与信任层，因为买方可以核查实际响应请求的是哪个模型，而不必依赖供应商的自述。其传导渠道是模型路由环节的责任与信任，而非代币供给或流动性；同时也会波及那些以密码学方式证明模型执行的“可验证推理”和 AI 智能体身份类项目。

dedup_history.ai_summary: GitBook disclosed that a highly targeted attack using AI agents gained unauthorized access to some of its infrastructure credentials, exposing potentially sensitive API tokens and integration secrets and prompting it to revoke customer tokens while crypto projects like PancakeSwap relocated their documentation.
dedup_history.author: Jose Antonio Lanz

metadata.background_en: GitBook is a documentation platform that combines a wiki-style editor with Git-based version control, and crypto projects rely on such platforms to publish technical explanations and developer guides. Its disclosure does not establish that GitBook's own AI products were responsible for the intrusion. The company kept publicly available documentation reachable through cached copies while its underlying systems were down.
metadata.background_zh: GitBook 是一个将 wiki 式编辑器与基于 Git 的版本控制相结合的文档平台，加密项目依赖此类平台发布技术说明和开发者指南。GitBook 的披露并未证实是其自家 AI 产品导致了此次入侵。在底层系统下线期间，该公司通过缓存副本让公开可读的文档保持可访问。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
GitBook disclosed that a "sophisticated, highly targeted attack using AI agents" gained unauthorized access to some of its infrastructure credentials at 7 p.m. Central European Time on November 2. The documentation platform, widely used by crypto projects, took authentication-gated sites offline, revoked personal API tokens and urged customers to replace connected credentials.

GitBook's connections to customer accounts and external services mean the blast radius extends to crypto teams' integration tokens, Git Sync secrets and API tokens. PancakeSwap responded by temporarily taking its documentation offline before moving it off the platform, while saying its own systems were not compromised.

GitBook said its investigation found no evidence that hosted content was modified, and that potentially exposed data includes integration tokens, Git Sync secrets, API tokens and questions submitted to its AI assistant. By Tuesday afternoon the company said its application, API and published documentation were accessible again, though some services could remain degraded; it has not explained how the attacker used the AI tools, which AI systems were involved, or how the credentials were obtained.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
GitBook 披露，一起“使用 AI 智能体的复杂、高度定向攻击”于欧洲中部时间 11 月 2 日晚 7 点未经授权访问了其部分基础设施凭证。这家被加密项目广泛使用的文档平台下线了需登录访问的站点，撤销了个人 API 令牌，并敦促客户更换已连接的凭证。

GitBook 与客户账户及外部服务的连接意味着影响范围波及加密团队的集成令牌、Git Sync 密钥和 API 令牌。PancakeSwap 的回应是先暂时下线其文档，随后将其迁出该平台，同时表示自身系统并未被入侵。

GitBook 表示调查未发现托管内容被篡改的证据，可能暴露的数据包括集成令牌、Git Sync 密钥、API 令牌以及提交给其 AI 助手的问题。公司称截至周二下午其应用、API 和已发布文档已恢复访问，但部分服务在恢复期间仍可能降级；它尚未解释攻击者如何使用这些 AI 工具、涉及哪些 AI 系统，以及凭证是如何被获取的。
metadata.market_impact_en: The channel here is credential and supply-chain risk rather than price: teams that connected GitBook to repositories, deployment pipelines or external services face potential exposure of integration and API tokens until those secrets are rotated. Documented migration off the platform by projects like PancakeSwap signals an operational, not a market-wide, disruption.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这里的传导渠道是凭证与供应链风险，而非价格：曾将 GitBook 连接到代码仓库、部署流水线或外部服务的团队，在相关密钥完成轮换之前面临集成令牌和 API 令牌可能暴露的风险。像 PancakeSwap 这样的项目将文档迁出平台，表明这是一次运营层面的扰动，而非全市场范围的冲击。

dedup_history.ai_summary: Simon Willison demonstrates that a locally run Qwen 3.8 27B can interpret raw model weights, extending the recent Weight-Space Programming findings beyond frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra.
dedup_history.author: Simon Willison

metadata.background_en: Weight-space programming refers to a general-purpose LLM reading, interpreting and directly writing another neural network's weights without gradient descent or a training loop; the term was coined in the Takehi et al. paper, which the authors classify as a blog post. GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's frontier model, released to approved users on September 3, 2026. Qwen 3.8 27B is an open-weight dense vision-language model from Qwen built on the Qwen3.5 architecture.
metadata.background_zh: 权重空间编程（Weight-Space Programming）指通用大模型在不使用梯度下降或训练循环的情况下，读取、解读并直接写入另一个神经网络的权重；该术语由 Takehi 等人的论文提出，作者本人将其归类为博客文章。GPT-6 Astra 是 OpenAI 的前沿模型，于 2026 年 9 月 3 日向获批用户开放。Qwen 3.8 27B 是 Qwen 推出的开放权重稠密视觉语言模型，基于 Qwen3.5 架构构建。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Simon Willison reported that Qwen 3.8 27B, running locally on his laptop, could interpret raw model weights in a replication of an example from the paper "Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights" by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang and Omar Khattab. That paper had demonstrated the capability with frontier models, specifically GPT-6 Astra.

The demonstration indicates that no-tools weight reading is not confined to frontier systems such as GPT-6 Astra, since an open-weight model running on a laptop reproduced one of the paper's examples. It remains an exploratory blog-post replication rather than a formal result or peer-reviewed finding.

The paper's first experiment trained four neural networks to play 10x10 grid versions of Breakout, Pong, Pac-Man and Freeway, then supplied the weights as floating-point numbers to an LLM with the instruction that it had no tools, no code execution and a single response to identify which game each network was trained on. Willison focused on this no-tools question, noting that critics Matthew Honnibal and Sean Goedecke disputed the paper's framing of code-assisted model editing.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Simon Willison 报告称，他在自己笔记本电脑上本地运行的 Qwen 3.8 27B 能够解读原始模型权重，复现了 Rikiya Takehi、Jayden Teoh、Alex Zhang 与 Omar Khattab 合著的论文《Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights》中的一个示例。该论文此前是以 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿模型展示这一能力的。

这一演示表明，无需工具即可读取权重的能力并不局限于 GPT-6 Astra 等前沿系统——一个在笔记本上运行的开放权重模型复现了论文中的一个示例。不过它仍属于探索性的博客复现，而非正式成果或同行评审结论。

论文的第一个实验训练了四个神经网络，让它们玩 10x10 网格版的 Breakout、Pong、Pac-Man 和 Freeway，随后把权重以浮点数形式交给大模型，并说明模型没有工具、不能执行代码、只有一次回答机会，要求其判断每个网络是为哪款游戏训练的。Willison 聚焦于这个“无工具”问题，并提到批评者 Matthew Honnibal 与 Sean Goedecke 对论文将借助代码编辑模型的做法归入同一概念提出质疑。
metadata.market_impact_en: The result concerns open-weight model research and local inference rather than any token or protocol, so there is no direct transmission to crypto assets; any effect would run only through sentiment around open-weight and decentralized-AI narratives. It is an interpretive demonstration, not a product or network change.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该成果属于开放权重模型研究与本地推理范畴，并不涉及任何代币或协议，因此对加密资产没有直接传导路径；若有影响，也仅通过围绕开放权重与去中心化 AI 叙事的情绪面体现。它是一项解读性演示，而非产品或网络层面的变更。

dedup_history.author: wublockchainenglish

metadata.background_en: Tether is the largest issuer of the USDT dollar-pegged stablecoin and has periodically disclosed Bitcoin holdings accumulated with company profits. Lugano, where the Plan ₿ Forum was held, has pursued a Bitcoin- and stablecoin-friendly municipal agenda. Tether has historically relied on independent accounting firms to attest to its reserves rather than publishing full audited financial statements.

metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Speaking in a keynote at the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano, Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said the company owns approximately 150,000 BTC and serves more than 730 million users, adding about 30 million new wallets per quarter. He cited Tether's Q3 2026 attestation, which showed roughly $122.8 billion in directly held U.S. Treasury bills — $132.4 billion including repurchase agreements — and about $7.95 billion in excess reserves.

The remarks make public the approximate scale of Bitcoin held by the largest stablecoin issuer, alongside reserve figures that market participants track when gauging USDT's backing. It was a keynote statement rather than an announcement of a new purchase or a regulatory filing.

The figures come from Tether's Q3 2026 attestation, a periodic assurance report rather than a full audit of the company's financial statements. Ardoino also described Tether's wider Independence Stack initiative, covering energy, Bitcoin mining, peer-to-peer communications, self-custody wallets and on-device AI.

dedup_history.ai_summary: CryptoCom will shut down its consumer app in Hong Kong on February 1, 2027, notifying users about account closures and fund withdrawals while continuing to seek an SFC virtual asset trading platform license through Foris DAX HK Limited for its institutional exchange.
dedup_history.author: wublockchainenglish

metadata.background_en: Under Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Ordinance and Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, centralized virtual asset trading platforms carrying on business in Hong Kong or actively marketing to Hong Kong investors must be licensed and regulated by the SFC. The SFC introduced a swift licensing process and a revamped second-phase assessment for platform applicants, and has granted licences to several applicants under that process. Foris DAX HK Limited appears on the SFC's published list of virtual asset trading platform operators.
metadata.background_zh: 根据香港《证券及期货条例》及《打击洗钱及恐怖分子资金筹集条例》，在香港经营业务或积极向香港投资者推广的中心化虚拟资产交易平台须获证监会发牌并受其监管。证监会此前推出快速发牌程序并更新了平台申请者的第二阶段评估，已据此向多家申请机构发牌。Foris DAX HK Limited 出现在证监会公布的虚拟资产交易平台名单之中。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
CryptoCom will discontinue its consumer app in Hong Kong effective February 1, 2027, according to Bloomberg. The company said the move is part of efforts to optimize global operations and resource allocation, and that affected users have been notified and will receive instructions on account closures and fund withdrawals.

The shutdown removes CryptoCom's retail-facing app from Hong Kong even as the company keeps pursuing an SFC virtual asset trading platform license through Foris DAX HK Limited for its institutional exchange, leaving Hong Kong consumer users with a fixed deadline to close accounts and withdraw funds.

The consumer app closure is dated February 1, 2027, and is framed as an operational and resource-allocation decision rather than a regulatory action or insolvency event. The institutional CryptoCom Exchange business and its separate licensing application in Hong Kong are described as continuing.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据彭博社报道，CryptoCom 将于 2027 年 2 月 1 日起停止在香港提供消费者应用。公司称此举是为优化全球运营与资源配置，并表示已通知受影响用户，后续将向其提供账户关闭与资金提取的指引。

此次停服意味着 CryptoCom 将撤出面向香港零售用户的应用程序，而公司同时仍在通过 Foris DAX HK Limited 为其机构级交易所申请香港证监会虚拟资产交易平台牌照，香港个人用户因此面临明确的账户关闭与提币期限。

消费者应用的下线日期为 2027 年 2 月 1 日，公司将其定位为运营与资源配置层面的决定，而非监管处罚或 insolvency 事件。面向机构的 CryptoCom Exchange 业务及其在香港另行推进的牌照申请据称将继续进行。
metadata.market_impact_en: The change affects Hong Kong retail users' custody arrangements, requiring them to move funds off the consumer app before the February 2027 deadline, and shifts local retail flow toward SFC-licensed platforms. It is a market-access and operational change for one jurisdiction rather than a platform-wide or solvency event.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 这一变化影响香港零售用户的资产托管安排，用户需在 2027 年 2 月前将资金从该消费者应用中转出，本地零售交易流量可能进一步向已获证监会发牌的平台集中。此事属于单一司法管辖区的市场准入与运营调整，而非平台层面或偿付能力层面的事件。

items.ai_summary: Coinbase pointed to its split-key cold storage design as the industry reassesses custody security following a reported $6.4B hack at Binance.
items.author: OneBullEx

metadata.background_en: Cold storage keeps private keys offline, while transactions are prepared and broadcast from connected devices; split-key designs divide key material so no single party or system holds a complete key. Binance co-founder Changpeng Zhao publicly addressed the incident, saying there is "no 100% security." Coinbase has long offered cold storage of customer coins as an alternative to self-custody.
metadata.background_zh: 冷存储将私钥置于离线环境，交易则通过联网设备构建并广播；分片密钥设计将密钥材料拆分，使任何单一主体或系统都不掌握完整密钥。币安联合创始人赵长鹏公开回应了该事件，称“没有100%的安全”。Coinbase长期提供客户币种的冷存储服务，作为自行托管的替代方案。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
In the wake of a reported $6.4 billion hack at Binance, Coinbase pointed to its split-key cold storage design and stated that 99% of customer assets are held in cold storage. The disclosure was framed as the industry re-examines custody security and key management.

The remarks shift attention to how exchanges architect key management, which is central to how customers and counterparties gauge custodial risk at a major venue.

Reports on the incident differ on magnitude, describing a $6.3 billion or $6.4 billion breach. Binance's own initial findings said about $6.34 billion of digital assets were affected in the Oct. 29 incident and that 98% of the impacted tokens had been replenished as of Oct. 31, verifiable on its proof-of-reserves page.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
在币安据报遭遇64亿美元黑客攻击后，Coinbase强调其分片密钥（split-key）冷存储架构，并表示99%的客户资产存放于冷存储之中。该表态被置于行业重新审视托管安全与密钥管理的背景下。

这一表态把焦点引向交易所如何设计密钥管理架构，而这一点正是客户与交易对手评估大型平台托管风险的核心。

各方报道对事件规模表述不一，有63亿美元与64亿美元两种说法。币安自身的初步调查称，10月29日事件影响约63.4亿美元数字资产，截至10月31日已有98%的受影响代币得到补充，并可在其储备证明页面核验。
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is custody and counterparty risk: large holders re-weighing where balances sit can shift spot liquidity, BTC and stablecoin flows between venues, and attention to proof-of-reserves disclosures. Exchange-linked tokens and custodial venues are the segments most directly in focus.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于托管与交易对手风险：大额持有者重新权衡资产存放地点，可能改变各平台间的现货流动性、BTC与稳定币流向，并提升对储备证明披露的关注度。与交易所相关的代币及提供托管服务的平台是受影响最直接的板块。

items.ai_summary: Riot Platforms signed a $28 billion AI lease covering its entire Corsicana campus, funding the data-center buildout partly by selling 20,264 BTC this year while mining still generated about 64% of third-quarter revenue.
items.author: The Defiant Team

metadata.background_en: Riot is the second-largest publicly listed Bitcoin miner, and the Corsicana lease is the largest of three AI/HPC deals it has signed this year as it shifts toward hosting AI compute. Third-quarter revenue was $181.4 million, up just 1% year over year, while Bitcoin mining revenue fell about 28% to $116 million and still supplied roughly 64% of quarterly revenue. Peer miner Hut 8, also pivoting toward AI infrastructure, saw its shares fall more than 22% intraday after third-quarter revenue dropped 15% to $71.1 million and missed estimates of $75.8 million.
metadata.background_zh: Riot 是第二大公开上市的比特币矿企，Corsicana 租约是其今年签署的三份 AI/HPC 交易中规模最大的一份，反映其向 AI 算力托管转型。第三季度营收为 1.814 亿美元，同比仅增长 1%；比特币挖矿收入同比下降约 28% 至 1.16 亿美元，仍占季度营收约 64%。同样在向 AI 基础设施转型的矿企 Hut 8 第三季度营收下降 15% 至 7,110 万美元，低于 7,580 万美元的预期，股价盘中一度下跌逾 22%。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Riot Platforms signed a 15-year data center lease covering the entirety of its Corsicana, Texas campus — 910 MW of critical IT capacity — at roughly $28 billion in total contract value and about $1.8 billion in average annual rent including escalators. The tenant, identified as Anthropic in the company's quarterly filing, will own and operate the computing equipment while Riot supplies land and power infrastructure originally developed for Bitcoin mining.

The deal lifts Riot's total contracted data center capacity to 1,151 MW and about $38 billion in long-term contract revenue across three leases signed this year. CEO Jason Les said that at full deployment of currently executed deals, nearly all of Riot's expected cash flow will come from long-term leases with AI players rather than from Bitcoin mining, and the shares rose more than 13% on the announcement.

Riot estimates total project capital costs at $5.5 billion, to be financed primarily through debt backed by lease payments, though that financing has not yet been secured. First-phase delivery is expected in September 2027 with rent payments starting within 60 days of delivery, and Les said Bitcoin mining at Corsicana could begin winding down in summer 2027. In the third quarter Riot sold 10,599 BTC, cutting holdings from 11,380 at end-June to 2,418 at end-September, and it sold 20,264 BTC over the first nine months for about $1.5 billion.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Riot Platforms 签署了一份为期 15 年的数据中心租约，覆盖其位于德克萨斯州 Corsicana 园区的全部 910 兆瓦关键 IT 容量，合同总价值约 280 亿美元，计入上调条款后的年均租金约 18 亿美元。公司在季报文件中披露租户为 Anthropic，该租户将自有关并运营计算设备，而 Riot 提供原本为比特币挖矿开发的土地与电力基础设施。

该交易使 Riot 今年签署的三份租约累计合同容量达到 1,151 兆瓦，长期合同收入约 380 亿美元。首席执行官 Jason Les 表示，在目前已签约项目全部部署后，公司预期现金流几乎全部来自与 AI 企业的长期租约，而非比特币挖矿；消息公布后公司股价上涨逾 13%。

Riot 预计项目总资本开支为 55 亿美元，主要将通过以租约为担保的债务融资，但该融资尚未落实。首期预计于 2027 年 9 月交付，租金在交付后 60 天内开始支付；Les 称 Corsicana 的比特币挖矿可能在 2027 年夏季开始逐步退出。第三季度 Riot 卖出 10,599 枚 BTC，持仓从 6 月底的 11,380 枚降至 9 月底的 2,418 枚；前九个月累计卖出 20,264 枚 BTC，套现约 15 亿美元。
metadata.market_impact_en: Riot's sale of 20,264 BTC (about $1.5 billion) this year to fund data center construction moves coins from a miner treasury onto the market, a supply channel traders watch alongside miners' shifting hash-rate allocation. If Corsicana's 910 MW is converted from mining to AI hosting by 2027, that capacity leaves the Bitcoin hashrate base while the company's revenue exposure shifts toward AI lease counterparties and the debt that will finance the $5.5 billion buildout.
metadata.market_impact_zh: Riot 今年为资助数据中心建设卖出 20,264 枚 BTC（约 15 亿美元），将矿企金库中的比特币释放到市场，这是交易者密切关注的供给渠道之一，同时矿工的算力配置也在发生变化。若 Corsicana 的 910 兆瓦在 2027 年前由挖矿转为 AI 托管，这部分算力将退出比特币哈希率基础，而公司的收入敞口将转向 AI 租户以及为 55 亿美元建设提供资金的债务。

items.ai_summary: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed it suffered a cyberattack enabling fraudulent operations one day after onchain investigator ZachXBT identified the French bank as the alleged victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million, with the bank saying the incident is contained and customer assets unaffected.
items.author: Decrypt Agent

metadata.background_en: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa is a French mutual banking group made up of the Crédit Mutuel de Bretagne and Crédit Mutuel du Sud-Ouest federations plus around 40 specialized subsidiaries, with about 5 million customers, according to its own website; ZachXBT described it as a French bank with $235 billion in assets. In May, French financial newspaper L'Agefi reported that the group had applied for a license under MiCA, the EU's crypto rulebook, to offer crypto services to retail customers and on a white-label basis through its Arkéa Banking Services division. ZachXBT did not say how he identified the bank or how the attacker gained access to its exchange accounts.
metadata.background_zh: 据其官网介绍，Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 是一家法国互助银行集团，由 Crédit Mutuel de Bretagne 与 Crédit Mutuel du Sud-Ouest 两大联合会及约 40 家专业子公司组成，拥有约 500 万客户；ZachXBT 则称其是一家资产规模 2350 亿美元的法国银行。今年 5 月，法国财经媒体 L'Agefi 报道称，该集团已根据欧盟加密规则 MiCA 申请牌照，以便向零售客户提供加密服务，并通过其 Arkéa Banking Services 部门提供白标服务。ZachXBT 未说明他是如何识别出该银行的，也未说明攻击者如何进入其交易所账户。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa confirmed in a statement to Decrypt on Wednesday that it was hit by a cyberattack that enabled fraudulent operations, saying the incident is "closed and now under control" and that operations are resuming gradually. The confirmation came one day after onchain investigator ZachXBT publicly named the bank as the alleged victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million.

The bank said it alerted the relevant supervisory authorities as soon as it detected the attack and temporarily suspended some transactions as a precaution. ZachXBT accused the institution of failing to make a "proper incident disclosure," which he said prevented law enforcement from freezing some $30 million in stolen funds.

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa did not mention crypto or state how much was taken, saying the affected amounts are still being assessed but are "in any event not of a nature to call into question the solidity and financial health of the group"; it said customer assets were unaffected and some transfers were only delayed. ZachXBT initially flagged more than $106 million in withdrawals from exchange accounts on November 1, later added $27 million, published four Ethereum addresses, and said he could state "with a high degree of confidence" the attacker is not the Lazarus Group.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
法国银行集团 Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 周三向 Decrypt 发表声明，确认其遭遇了一次使欺诈性操作得以进行的网络攻击，称事件已“关闭并处于控制之下”，业务正在逐步恢复。这一确认出现在链上调查员 ZachXBT 公开指认该行为超过 1.33 亿美元加密货币盗窃案疑似受害方的次日。

该行表示在发现攻击后立即通报了相关监管机构，并作为预防措施暂停了部分交易。ZachXBT 则指责该机构未进行“适当的事件披露”，称这导致执法部门无法冻结约 3000 万美元被盗资金。

Crédit Mutuel Arkéa 未提及加密货币，也未说明被盗金额，称受影响金额仍在评估中，但“无论如何都不足以动摇集团的稳健性与财务健康”；该行称客户资产未受影响，只是部分转账执行被延迟。ZachXBT 最初指出 11 月 1 日有逾 1.06 亿美元从交易所账户被提走，随后追加 2700 万美元，并公布了四个以太坊地址，还表示可以“高度确信”攻击者并非 Lazarus 组织。
metadata.market_impact_en: The alleged proceeds moved as USDC and USDT withdrawn from exchange accounts, then swapped into ETH, routed through instant exchanges, partly converted to Monero and bridged across multiple chains — a laundering path that touches stablecoin liquidity at centralized venues, cross-chain bridges and privacy-coin markets. The case also puts EU incident-disclosure practices and bank-linked crypto custody in focus as the group pursues a MiCA license, a channel that affects institutional sentiment toward regulated crypto access in Europe.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 疑似赃款以从交易所账户提取的 USDC 和 USDT 形式流出，随后兑换为 ETH、经即时交易平台转移、部分转为门罗币并跨多条链桥接——这一洗钱路径涉及中心化平台的稳定币流动性、跨链桥以及隐私币市场。与此同时，在该集团申请 MiCA 牌照的背景下，此案也使欧盟的事件披露实践与银行系加密托管受到关注，这一渠道会影响机构对欧洲受监管加密准入的情绪。

items.ai_summary: BitMart confirmed a fresh hack while its founder Sheldon Xia admitted on X that the exchange's security team is severely understaffed following restructuring, with analysts flagging suspicious transfers possibly tied to the recent Mercado Bitcoin attack.
items.author: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

metadata.background_en: BitMart announced in July that it would end trading on Aug. 26 and cease operations in January 2027, after which users reported delayed withdrawals and frozen accounts. In August, the exchange's Chinese-language X account alleged that employees had gone unpaid and demanded answers about customer funds; Xia dismissed the allegations as fabricated. A restructuring proposal published Monday outlined three potential recovery options for users, including liquid asset distributions and recovery-linked tokens, with the exchange planning to seek court approval in December or January.
metadata.background_zh: BitMart于7月宣布将于8月26日停止交易，并于2027年1月停止运营，此后用户报告提现延迟和账户被冻结。8月，该交易所的中文X账号称员工未获薪资，并要求就客户资金作出解释，Xia则称这些说法系捏造。周一发布的重组方案为用户列出了三种潜在回收选项，包括流动资产分配和与追偿挂钩的代币，交易所计划在12月或1月寻求法院批准。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
BitMart confirmed a new hack on Monday, and founder Sheldon Xia said in a post on X on Wednesday that the exchange's security team is "currently severely understaffed" following restructuring. Xia described the amount involved as small without disclosing a figure, while blockchain analytics firm Bitquery identified approximately $391,000 in suspicious transfers from wallets mostly associated with BitMart across three blockchains.

Bitquery traced the funds to a wallet also implicated in the more than $46 million Mercado Bitcoin hack on Monday, Nov. 2, supporting Xia's preliminary suspicion of a possible connection between the two incidents.

Xia said threats against employees and alleged retaliation by former staff had complicated efforts to retain technical personnel. Cointelegraph said it had contacted BitMart for details on the restructuring, security staffing and the latest breach but had not received a response by publication.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
BitMart证实周一发生了一起新的黑客攻击，创始人Sheldon Xia周三在X上发文称，重组之后该交易所的安全团队“目前严重人手不足”。Xia称涉案金额不大，但未披露具体数字；区块链分析公司Bitquery则在调查中识别出约39.1万美元的可疑转账，涉及三条区块链上主要与BitMart相关的钱包。

Bitquery将这些资金追溯到一个同样涉及11月2日（周一）Mercado Bitcoin逾4600万美元黑客事件的钱包，这支持了Xia关于两起事件可能存在关联的初步怀疑。

Xia表示，针对员工的威胁以及前员工所称的报复行为，使留住技术人员的工作变得复杂。Cointelegraph称已就重组、安全团队人员配置及最新攻击事件联系BitMart，但截至发稿未获回复。

A change of majority hands the committee gavels that shape digital-asset bills to the other party, altering which market-structure proposals can advance and in what form.

The House outcome has been called, but Hill's own race remains uncalled, leaving the identity of a prominent Republican voice on crypto policy unsettled.

items.ai_summary: Strategy raised $5.4B from July through September but spent only $588M on bitcoin while selling 5,552 BTC to fund dividends and STRC repurchases.
items.author: Aaron Wise

metadata.background_en: Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, has repositioned itself as a "bitcoin treasury company" and funds most purchases by selling stock at the market (ATM), since operations generate minimal cash flow. Its STRC is a perpetual preferred stock paying 12.00% annual dividends, with a rate adjusted monthly to encourage trading near its $100 par value; the article notes it actually traded in the $70s and $80s for months, making repurchases costly.
metadata.background_zh: Strategy（原 MicroStrategy）已将自身重新定位为“比特币储备公司”，由于经营性现金流极少，其购币资金主要来自按市价增发股票（ATM）。其 STRC 是一只年股息率 12.00% 的永续优先股，股息率每月调整，以促使其价格在 100 美元面值附近交易；文章指出该股实际连续数月跌至 70 至 80 美元区间，令回购成本高昂。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Strategy raised $5.4 billion through at-the-market common stock sales between July and September but spent only $588 million of that on bitcoin — less than 11 cents of every dollar raised. The company also sold 5,552 of its own BTC for $348.6 million, partly to fund dividends and partly to repurchase its STRC preferred stock.

The disclosure breaks a pattern: in 2024 essentially every ATM dollar became bitcoin, and even in the anomalous third quarter of 2025 more than 94 cents of each dollar still bought BTC. The shift matters because Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin treasury, so the share of its fundraising that reaches spot BTC purchases is a directly observable demand channel.

Strategy bought 7,218 BTC during the quarter and, after accounting for its sales, ended with just 1,666 more coins than it started with. In the reporting week of October 26, $164 million of fresh MSTR dilution saw only 40 cents of each dollar go toward BTC.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Strategy 在 7 月至 9 月期间通过按市价（ATM）增发普通股融资 54 亿美元，但其中仅 5.88 亿美元用于购买比特币，相当于每融资 1 美元投入比特币不足 11 美分。公司同期还卖出 5,552 枚自有比特币，套现 3.486 亿美元，部分用于支付股息，部分用于回购其 STRC 优先股。

这一披露打破了此前的模式：2024 年几乎每一美元 ATM 融资都变成了比特币，即便在表现异常的 2025 年第三季度，每 1 美元中仍有逾 94 美分用于买入比特币。其意义在于，Strategy 是最大的企业级比特币储备公司，其融资中最终流向现货比特币购买的比例，是一条可直接观察的需求渠道。

Strategy 当季共买入 7,218 枚比特币，扣除卖出部分后，净持仓仅比季初增加 1,666 枚。在 10 月 26 日当周的披露中，新增 1.64 亿美元 MSTR 增发，每 1 美元中仅 40 美分用于购买比特币。
metadata.market_impact_en: MSTR stock is a widely used proxy for indirect bitcoin exposure, and STRC is a yield instrument tied to the same balance sheet. If a smaller share of each new dollar raised converts into spot BTC purchases while some coins are sold to fund preferred dividends and buybacks, the marginal demand contribution from this treasury channel weakens and the supply side of that channel turns slightly positive.
metadata.market_impact_zh: MSTR 股票被广泛用作间接持有比特币的替代标的，STRC 则是与同一张资产负债表挂钩的收益型工具。当每新增 1 美元融资中流入现货比特币购买的比例下降、同时又有比特币被卖出以支付优先股股息和回购时，这一储备渠道的边际需求贡献随之减弱，其供给方向则略微转为正向。

The preview extends Stripe's stablecoin offering beyond holding balances in Treasury to sending funds directly to external wallets across borders, giving US business customers a new payout channel denominated in stablecoins.

The preview supports only two stablecoins, USDC and Open USD, and transfers are funded from a Treasury balance. New York-based businesses are excluded.

items.ai_summary: Blast announced its L2 has formally shut down, with users holding ETH or USD in L2 wallets, pending withdrawals, or Blast Mobile able to reclaim assets through the official website, which will remain open for 12 months until November 4, 2027.
items.author: foresightnews

metadata.background_en: Blast was a Paradigm-backed Ethereum layer-2 that at its peak held roughly $2.3 billion in value. According to Decrypt, the team said running the network cost more than it earned and that it had no credible path to sustainability, which led to the wind-down.
metadata.background_zh: Blast 是由 Paradigm 支持的以太坊 Layer 2，巅峰时期网络锁仓价值约 23 亿美元。据 Decrypt 报道，团队表示运营该网络的成本高于其收入，且没有可信的可持续路径，因此决定逐步关停。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Blast announced on X that its L2 network has formally shut down. Users still holding ETH or USD in L2 wallets, in pending withdrawals, or in Blast Mobile can reclaim their assets through the Blast official website, which will remain available for 12 months with a final support date of November 4, 2027.

The asset-recovery site is time-limited, with November 4, 2027 set as the last supported date. Earlier reporting indicated that Blast's standard withdrawal interface closed on October 26, after which users must interact directly with Ethereum bridge contracts to move assets.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Blast 在 X 平台发推宣布，其 L2 网络已正式关停。仍在 L2 钱包、待处理提现或 Blast Mobile 中持有 ETH 或 USD 的用户，可通过 Blast 官网取回资产；该取回网站将运行 12 个月，最终支持日期为 2027 年 11 月 4 日。

资产取回网站设有明确期限，2027 年 11 月 4 日为最后支持日期。此前的报道称，Blast 的标准提现界面已于 10 月 26 日关闭，此后用户需直接与以太坊桥合约交互才能转移资产。
metadata.market_impact_en: The closure shifts any residual ETH and stablecoin liquidity out of Blast's L2 and back toward Ethereum mainnet or competing L2s, with assets routed through the bridge contracts during recovery. It also feeds the broader reassessment of L2 token and incentive models, since Blast's economics were judged unsustainable by its own team.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 关停将把 Blast L2 中残留的 ETH 与稳定币流动性转移回以太坊主网或其他竞争性 L2，资产在取回过程中需经由桥合约流转。由于 Blast 团队自认其经济模型不可持续，此事也会加剧市场对 L2 代币与激励模式的重新评估。

items.ai_summary: Circle's Q3 earnings call revealed development of Arc Sectors — including a privacy sector, a payments sector targeting over 100,000 TPS, and an AI Agent sector expected to go live by Q1 2027 — while reporting CPN annualized payment volume above $58B, record $208B USDC mint/redeem, and USDC capturing 79% of stablecoin on-chain volume.
items.author: foresightnews

metadata.background_en: Arc is Circle's enterprise-grade blockchain positioned as an "economic operating system" for internet-native finance, sitting alongside USDC and the Circle Payments Network in the company's stack. Circle has said Arc uses USDC-denominated fees, and CPN connects financial institutions to orchestrate payments in fiat, USDC and other payment stablecoins.
metadata.background_zh: Arc 是 Circle 面向企业级应用的区块链，被定位为互联网原生金融的“经济操作系统”，与 USDC 和 Circle 支付网络共同构成公司产品体系。Circle 曾表示 Arc 使用以 USDC 计价的费用；CPN 则连接金融机构，用于协调法币、USDC 及其他支付稳定币的支付流转。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
On its Q3 earnings call, Circle said it is developing "Arc Sectors" for its Arc chain — dedicated lanes for different types of financial activity, including a privacy sector for institutions with selective confidentiality and disclosure, a payments sector targeting more than 100,000 transactions per second, and an AI Agent sector with identity verification and audit trails. Circle expects AI agents to be discoverable, hireable, payable and trusted on Arc by the first quarter of 2027.

The disclosure pairs a concrete infrastructure roadmap with strong network metrics: Circle Payments Network annualized payment volume exceeded $58 billion, up more than 150% from $23 billion on July 31, with 205 financial institutions having joined, and Circle expects CPN to contribute meaningful revenue in 2027.

As of late October, about $1.5 billion in USDC, cirBTC and EURC was held on Arc, with over $30 billion in USDC having flowed through the chain since launch at roughly 500,000 daily transactions. In Q3, USDC accounted for 79% of stablecoin on-chain transaction volume versus 66% a year earlier, while USDC mint and redeem totaled a record $208 billion, up 42% year over year.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Circle 在三季度财报电话会上透露，正在为其 Arc 链开发“分区”（Arc Sectors）功能，为不同类型的金融活动提供专属通道：面向机构、支持选择性保密与披露的隐私分区，目标每秒处理超 10 万笔交易的支付分区，以及具备身份验证与审计追踪的 AI Agent 分区。Circle 预计到 2027 年一季度，AI Agent 可在 Arc 上被发现、雇用、支付并获得信任。

此次披露将具体的基础设施路线图与强劲的网络数据并列：Circle 支付网络（CPN）年化支付量已超 580 亿美元，较 7 月 31 日的 230 亿美元增长逾 150%，已有 205 家金融机构加入，Circle 预计 CPN 将在 2027 年贡献可观收入。

截至 10 月下旬，Arc 上的 USDC、cirBTC 及 EURC 总量约 15 亿美元，上线以来已有超 300 亿美元 USDC 在 Arc 上流转，日交易量约 50 万笔。三季度 USDC 占稳定币链上交易量的 79%，去年同期为 66%；USDC 铸造与赎回总额达创纪录的 2080 亿美元，同比增长 42%。
metadata.market_impact_en: The roadmap matters mainly for stablecoin market structure: a payments lane pitched at 100,000+ TPS plus a compliance-oriented privacy sector would concentrate institutional settlement flows on Circle's own chain, strengthening USDC's role as settlement asset against rival stablecoins and bank-issued tokens. The CPN volume figures give payment integrators and stablecoin issuers a concrete benchmark for how quickly on-chain settlement is displacing traditional rails.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 该路线图主要影响稳定币市场结构：一条标称每秒 10 万笔以上的支付通道，加上面向合规的隐私分区，可能把机构结算流量集中到 Circle 自有链上，从而在与其他稳定币及银行发行的代币竞争中强化 USDC 的结算资产地位。CPN 的支付量数据则为支付集成方与稳定币发行方提供了具体参照，显示链上结算替代传统通道的速度。

items.ai_summary: Moonshot AI released the open weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro, drawing strong Hacker News discussion about its capabilities, benchmark performance, and availability through third-party inference providers.
items.author: abrarthought

metadata.background_en: Open weights are the publicly released learned parameters of a trained model, allowing anyone to download and run it locally, though not necessarily with open training data or licence terms. Moonshot AI is the developer of the Kimi model family; search listings state that Kimi K3.1 Pro and a Highspeed variant are live on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and the company's API.
metadata.background_zh: 开放权重指已训练模型公开释放的学习参数，任何人都可以下载并在本地运行，但这并不必然意味着训练数据或授权条款同样开放。Moonshot AI 是 Kimi 系列模型的开发方；检索结果显示，Kimi K3.1 Pro 及一个 Highspeed 版本已在 Kimi.ai、Kimi Work、Kimi Code 和公司 API 上线。
metadata.community_discussion_en: Sentiment was broadly positive but split on benchmark credibility: several commenters called the model "benchmaxxed," while another pushed back that their testing did not show this. Others focused on practicalities — the hardware needed to self-host, and the rapid arrival of cheaper or faster third-party inference.
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 整体情绪偏正面，但对基准成绩的可信度存在分歧：多位评论者称该模型“刷榜”（benchmaxxed），也有人反驳说自己的测试没有发现这种情况。另一些人关注实际问题，如自行部署所需的硬件，以及更便宜、更快的第三方推理服务迅速出现。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Moonshot AI has published the open weights for Kimi K3.1 Pro, with the model repository live on Hugging Face for download and self-hosting. The release drew 426 points and 125 comments on Hacker News, where users noted that third-party inference providers began listing the model within hours.

Commenters reported that third-party providers are already serving the model, with one saying Together offers roughly double the throughput of Moonshot AI's own endpoint at the same price and Modal roughly double that again — a sign that hosted access is opening up beyond the releasing lab.

Discussion centered on whether the model is tuned to maximize benchmarks: one commenter argued it does not clearly outpace DeepSeekV4.1-Flash and scores modestly on another lab's internal benchmarks, while another said their own testing did not show benchmark-gaming and called it a strong open model slightly off the frontier. One user estimated running it locally would require something like an 8x B300 node.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Moonshot AI 已公开 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的模型权重，模型仓库已在 Hugging Face 上线，可供下载和自行部署。该发布在 Hacker News 上获得 426 分和 125 条评论，有用户指出第三方推理服务商在数小时内就开始上架该模型。

评论者表示第三方服务商已经开始提供该模型，其中一位称 Together 在相同价格下的吞吐量约为 Moonshot AI 自家端点的两倍，而 Modal 又是其两倍左右，显示托管访问渠道正在发布方之外迅速铺开。

讨论集中在模型是否针对基准测试做了优化：一位评论者认为它并未明显超越 DeepSeekV4.1-Flash，且在另一家实验室的内部基准上得分一般；另一位则表示自己的测试未发现“刷榜”迹象，称其是一款略逊于前沿但表现出色的开放模型。有用户估计本地运行大约需要 8 张 B300 的节点。
metadata.market_impact_en: A widely downloadable open-weight model with multiple competing hosted endpoints affects crypto AI infrastructure mainly through inference pricing: decentralized compute and inference marketplaces compete on the same serving demand, and the entrants cited in the thread put pressure on per-token costs. The effect runs through commoditized model serving rather than through any token supply or custody channel.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 一款可广泛下载的开放权重模型，加上多个相互竞争的托管端点，主要通过推理定价影响加密 AI 基础设施：去中心化算力与推理市场面对的是同一批服务需求，讨论中提到的这些新进入者对每 token 成本构成压力。其传导路径在于模型服务的商品化，而非代币供应或托管渠道。

items.ai_summary: A Democratic sweep of Congress forces the crypto industry to overhaul its Washington lobbying and legislative strategy, as the prior bipartisan pathway for market-structure and digital-asset bills is replaced by a more adversarial policy environment.
items.author: The Block

metadata.background_en: Crypto legislation had been advancing on a bipartisan track: the CLARITY Act, a market-structure bill, passed the House on July 17, 2025, by a vote of 294 to 134. In 2026, the bipartisan PARITY Act was introduced to address digital-asset taxation, and House Democrats discussed their own market-structure bill that would give the SEC a larger role and the CFTC a smaller one.
metadata.background_zh: 加密立法此前一直沿着两党轨道推进：市场结构法案 CLARITY Act 于 2025 年 7 月 17 日以 294 票对 134 票在众议院通过。2026 年，两党又提出处理数字资产税收问题的 PARITY Act，同时众议院民主党人讨论了他们自己的市场结构法案，该法案将赋予 SEC 更大角色、赋予 CFTC 更小角色。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
A Democratic sweep of Congress has forced the crypto industry to overhaul its Washington lobbying and legislative strategy, The Block reported. The bipartisan pathway the industry had pursued for market-structure and digital-asset bills has been replaced by a more adversarial policy environment.

The result removes the bipartisan legislative route the industry had used to advance market-structure and digital-asset bills, making Washington a more adversarial venue for crypto policy.

The reported change is a strategic and political shift rather than an immediate rule change or a market-access event.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
据 The Block 报道，民主党横扫国会迫使加密行业全面调整其在华盛顿的游说和立法策略。行业此前推动市场结构与数字资产法案的两党路径，已被更具对抗性的政策环境取代。

这一结果使行业此前用来推进市场结构与数字资产法案的两党立法路径不复存在，华盛顿对加密政策而言成为更具对抗性的场域。

报道所述的变化属于战略和政治层面的转变，而非立即生效的规则变更或市场准入事件。
metadata.market_impact_en: The main transmission channel is regulatory and legislative risk: a more adversarial Congress reduces the near-term likelihood of the market-structure and digital-asset bills the industry had backed, affecting sentiment and compliance planning for U.S.-exposed exchanges, token issuers and stablecoin businesses. It does not by itself change any rule or market-access regime.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 主要传导渠道是监管与立法风险：一个更具对抗性的国会降低了行业此前支持的市场结构与数字资产法案在短期内的推进可能性，从而影响面向美国的交易所、代币发行方和稳定币企业的市场情绪与合规规划。这一结果本身并不改变任何规则或市场准入制度。

items.ai_summary: Anthropic published a research approach for provable LLM inference that uses commitments to model weights and per-request cryptographic proofs so clients can verify which weights actually served their requests.
items.author: ltononro

metadata.background_en: FlashProve involves two parties: the model provider as prover and the user as verifier. Anthropic said the work advances zkSNARKs, a class of cryptographic proof it describes as uniquely suited to provable inference because of their hiding and efficiency properties.
metadata.background_zh: FlashProve 涉及两方：作为证明者的模型提供方和作为验证者的用户。Anthropic 表示这项工作推进了 zkSNARK 的应用，并称这类密码学证明因其隐藏性与效率特性而特别适合可验证推理。
metadata.community_discussion_en: A commenter who said they developed prior work called VerInf, which the approach builds on, said the design including the choice of a 400B Maverick model came from that work with little attribution. Others welcomed the result as a step forward but argued cheaper alternatives exist — running the same non-batched prompt through four independent inference providers for a probabilistic proof, or, for open-weight models, simply redoing the computation deterministically. Several commenters noted the scheme could also catch providers that silently route requests to other models.
metadata.community_discussion_zh: 一位评论者称自己此前做过名为 VerInf 的工作，而该方案正是建立在其之上，并表示包括选用 400B Maverick 模型在内的设计来自那项工作，却几乎没有得到署名。其他人欢迎这一成果，但认为存在更便宜的替代方案：把同一非批处理提示交给四个独立推理提供方以获得概率性证明，或者对于开放权重模型直接确定性地重算一遍。还有评论者指出，该方案也能识别出把请求悄悄路由到其他模型的提供方。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Anthropic published a research approach, called FlashProve, for provable inference of large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models: the model provider commits to its weights, then issues one zkSNARK proof per request so a client can verify which weights actually served it. Anthropic said it demonstrated the system on a 400-billion-parameter model.

The scheme targets a trust gap in hosted model serving — letting a customer confirm which weights ran on a provider's servers rather than relying on the provider's word. Commenters described it as a significant improvement over earlier zero-knowledge results, while noting the roughly 90-100x compute overhead limits near-term practicality.

According to discussion of the report, the weight commitment is about 6.5 MB and remains valid for roughly 16 million requests before the provider must commit again, with one proof issued per request. Verifying a proof takes about 17 seconds on 24 threads and 21 seconds on a single thread, including the check from the offline phase.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
Anthropic 公布了一种名为 FlashProve 的研究方案，用于大型混合专家（MoE）语言模型的可验证推理：模型提供方先对模型权重做出承诺，随后为每个请求生成一份 zkSNARK 证明，使客户端能够核实实际为其提供服务的是哪一套权重。Anthropic 表示已在一个 4000 亿参数模型上演示了该系统。

该方案针对的是托管模型服务中的信任缺口：让客户能够确认提供方服务器上实际运行的权重，而不是仅凭提供方的一面之词。有评论者认为这相较此前的零知识方案是显著改进，同时指出约 90-100 倍的计算开销限制了它在短期内的实用性。

据讨论中引述的报告内容，权重承诺约 6.5 MB，在提供方需要重新承诺之前大约可用于 1600 万次请求，每个请求生成一份证明。验证一份证明在 24 线程上约需 17 秒、单线程约需 21 秒，其中包含对离线阶段的校验。
metadata.market_impact_en: The crypto transmission path runs through zero-knowledge proof infrastructure: FlashProve relies on zkSNARKs, the same proof systems used by zkML and verifiable-compute networks, so progress on proving large-model inference bears on how those projects frame feasibility and cost. The 90-100x overhead described in discussion suggests the technique is not yet a practical substitute for existing serving or verification designs, and no token, venue or protocol is directly implicated by the research itself.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 与加密市场的传导路径在零知识证明基础设施一侧：FlashProve 依赖 zkSNARK，而这正是 zkML 与可验证计算网络所使用的证明系统，因此大模型推理证明的进展会影响这类项目对可行性与成本的叙事。讨论中提到的 90-100 倍开销表明该技术尚不足以替代现有的服务或验证设计，且该研究本身并未直接涉及任何代币、交易场所或协议。

items.ai_summary: Google is facing political backlash over a plan that would cut off Search access for schools that restrict AI, with critics like Zohran Mamdani and Lina Khan calling it monopolistic bundling.
items.author: Amanda Silberling

metadata.background_en: Lina Khan chaired the Federal Trade Commission from 2021 to 2025, where she became a leading voice in antitrust and competition law. Bundling — selling or tying several products together from a single seller — is a long-standing category of antitrust scrutiny. The Guardian has solicited reactions from parents and teachers about Google's decision.
metadata.background_zh: 莉娜·汗在2021年至2025年担任美国联邦贸易委员会主席，是反垄断与竞争法领域的重要人物。捆绑销售——即由同一卖家将多项产品或服务打包提供——长期以来是反垄断审查的一类情形。《卫报》已就谷歌这一决定向家长和教师征集看法。
metadata.detailed_summary_en:
Google is drawing political backlash over a plan under which schools that bar or fully restrict AI tools would lose access to Google Search. New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani and former FTC chair Lina Khan criticized the move as the behavior of an unregulated monopoly.

The dispute turns a product decision about schools into a public test of how far a dominant platform can link one service to another, and it drew condemnation from prominent antitrust figures rather than regulators themselves.

Google VP of education Chris Phillips told the New York Times that "Search and A.I. are deeply integrated," and that students at schools banning AI "will not have access to search" and will instead see a message from their school saying it is unavailable. The criticism has so far come as public pressure rather than a formal regulatory or legal complaint.
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
谷歌一项计划引发政治反弹：凡是禁止或全面限制AI工具的学校，将失去谷歌搜索的访问权限。纽约市市长佐兰·马姆达尼（Zohran Mamdani）和前美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）主席莉娜·汗（Lina Khan）批评此举是“不受监管的垄断者”行为。

这场争议把一项面向学校的取舍变成了公开检验：一家占主导地位的平台能在多大程度上把一项服务与另一项捆绑。发声批评的是知名反垄断人士，而非监管机构本身。

谷歌教育业务副总裁克里斯·菲利普斯（Chris Phillips）对《纽约时报》表示，“搜索与AI已深度整合”，禁止AI的学校的学生“将无法使用搜索”，而是会看到学校方面提示该功能不可用的信息。目前的批评仍属公开施压，尚未形成正式的监管或法律申诉。
metadata.market_impact_en: There is no direct crypto-market transmission here; the relevant channel is regulatory precedent, since how bundling of AI and search is treated at public institutions could shape the antitrust framing later applied to platform-level AI distribution.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 此事对加密市场没有直接的传导路径；相关渠道在于监管先例——公共机构中AI与搜索的捆绑如何处理，可能影响日后针对平台级AI分发的反垄断定性。
